Summary Collaboration Themes: Their collaboration integrates computer science machine-learning methods with electrical and computer engineering perspectives on secure, interpretable AI. They use DQN-based active learning to improve black-box model extraction attacks on image classifiers, evaluate synthetic-data and data-free techniques, and develop an open-source framework. In parallel, they apply information-theoretic entropy to capsule-network dynamic routing, improving CIFAR-10 accuracy and interpretability. Their systematic review connects generative AI advances to deepfake detection, digital forensics, and societal risk mitigation. Together, these works establish a cross-discipline theme of adversarial AI security, uncertainty-aware learning, and scalable trustworthy vision systems, combining algorithm development, benchmark evaluation, and evidence-driven analysis for real-world cybersecurity applications.
